summary: Iteration 7 — Patient intake (v2 Nigeria-focused, 7 sections) + Doctor onboarding wiring verified. Backend: 7/7 new tests pass (schema v2, /mine pending→completed, submit with past_illnesses=['Hypertension','Diabetes'] → user.lga/occupation/smoking/goals/next_of_kin_name mirrored, chronic_conditions auto-merged Hypertension+Diabetes, signals.care_segment includes 'diabetic'+'hypertensive', risk_score recomputed, RBAC blocks patient→doctor_onboarding submit, doctor_onboarding 400s when attestations false, /profile/me + /profile/sections/mine regression OK). Frontend: Patient OTP login (+2348012345678) → /patient → intake modal (qx-patient_intake) auto-opens with 'Step 1 of 7 · About you', close button (qx-close-patient_intake) works, banner CTA (intake-banner-cta) visible after close, CTA reopens modal. Doctor email login → /doctor → doctor_onboarding modal (qx-doctor_onboarding) auto-opens with 'Step 1 of 4', close works, doctor-onboarding-cta banner visible, CTA reopens. All review-request items confirmed working.
action_items: OPTIONAL CLEANUP: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and /app/backend/tests/test_appointments_and_notifications.py contain ~55 stale tests that try to login patient with email/password (patient@medinest.africa) — but patient auth was migrated to phone-OTP. Doctor attestations enforcement is server-side via required_true list (questionnaire_service.py:316-318) — 400 is returned with a clear message identifying which key failed. UI must mark these 4 fields red if false. Worth double-checking that QuestionnaireRunner surfaces this 400 to the doctor (out of scope for this run).

patient_intake mirror_keys (questionnaire_service.py:342-361) covers all 51 fields except past_illnesses_other (intentional — special handling via cond_map). Confirmed mirror_keys list is comprehensive.
ConsultationRoom.jsx:314-322 correctly passes dismissible={false} to QuestionnaireRunner — verified by code review. Both onClose and onSubmitted navigate to /doctor.

PatientDashboard auto-open gate uses localStorage `mdn_intake_dismissed_<userId>` — persistent across refresh as designed. DoctorDashboard uses `mdn_dx_onboarding_dismissed_<userId>` — same pattern. Verified via UI test (after close, modal stays closed; CTA click re-opens without persistence).

Pre-existing test files /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and test_appointments_and_notifications.py reference the obsolete patient@medinest.africa email login (now phone-OTP). Recommend cleanup.
